title: Live text on the pill while dictating + catch dictations that come back much too short
description: Erik 2026-10-07: 'I want to see the transcription being done live' after 50 s of Spanish gave one sentence (11:06, 11:07; not reproduced on clean or noisy copies of his voice, so the cause is unknown). Live: quick greedy pass every 2 s on the last 15 s, shown on the pill, skipped whenever the model is busy/loading; the careful pass is still what gets pasted. Diagnostics: delivered log gets speech_s + dropout_s; a result under 4 chars/s on >=15 s keeps its audio in data/suspect (last 5).

description: Erik 2026-10-07: rename before going public; 'Dictado' clashes with Dictato (a paid local Mac dictation app) and several iPhone apps. Picked Ogma after availability checks (0 voice/dictation projects named Ogma).
design: Phase 1 (this): everything visible -> Ogma: window/tray/pill/toasts/prompts, installer display names + Setup file names, README/FEATURES/guide, GitHub repo ErikBros/ogma (redirect). Internals unchanged: package dictado, Dictado.exe, data dirs, Run key, bundle id, MCP key. Phase 2 (after the Mac stack merges): package rename, exe name, data dir migration, installer upgrade from Dictado (old dir + Run key), MCP key, Mac bundle id (re-grant TCC), speaker add-on name.
notes:
Erik 2026-10-07: Ogma dropped ('weird word'); Echotype/Echoscribe taken in transcription; picked Ecoscribe (6 repos, none voice; GitHub user free).
2026-10-07 phase 2 Windows half (PR #17): package ecoscribe, Ecoscribe.exe 1.7.0, paths.migrate (Win + Mac dirs), installer upgrade from Dictado, Run key + Claude link renamed. Installed on Windows: both folders moved (7.5 GB, config identical), old Programs\Dictado + Run value + shortcut gone, ready on CUDA, selftest + GPU suite pass. Left: the Mac half (Ecoscribe.app, bundle ids, speakers app, LaunchAgent, TCC, darwin migrate test); Windows speaker add-on name = dictado-jtv.

title: Languages as add-ons: base English + Swedish, 'Add a language' for the rest
description: Erik 2026-10-07: 'I dont want languages to be in dictado by default. They should be add-ons and start only with english, swedish and english + swedish.' Picked: an 'Add a language' picker in Settings (no download, Whisper knows ~99); his own setup keeps Spanish + Greek added.
design: Base: en, sv. [whisper] extra_languages = added codes (Erik: es, el). Everywhere (dictation checkboxes, meeting/file language lists, tray, prompt) offers base + added; meetings also get 'Mixed: your languages' (detected per piece, generalises el,es) + Detect. Dictation model: large-v3 when any chosen language isn't one turbo handles well (sv, el and lower-resource ones). Names for any code via a shared table checked against faster-whisper's list. Removing an added language also drops it from the dictation set.
close_reason: Merged to main and shipped in Ecoscribe 1.6.0 (installed on Windows 2026-10-07).

title: Dictation: your languages (any mix of en/es/sv/el), auto-detect among them, language shown on the pill, Right Ctrl+L forces the next one
description: Erik 2026-10-06: 'why can't I choose in which language you should transcribe? auto suggest?'. Picked: tick your languages + auto. His languages: English, Spanish, Swedish, Greek.
design: Settings: multi-select languages (en, es, sv, el; any mix, Greek new for dictation), saved without a restart where possible. Auto: detect among only those per dictation; sticky toward the last language when the call is close. Model: sv or el in the set -> large-v3 (int8_float16), else turbo. Pill: '✓ ES' briefly after the paste when >1 language. Override: hold the dictation key + L cycles the NEXT dictation Auto -> EN -> ES -> SV -> EL -> Auto, pill shows it; L swallowed. Windows in this PR; Mac key = new capability row with a macos ticket.
close_reason: Merged to main and shipped in Ecoscribe 1.6.0 (installed on Windows 2026-10-07).

title: macOS: dictation key + L picks the next dictation's language
description: Windows (dictado-bvf): holding the dictation key and pressing L emits a 'lang' action (App.cycle_language: Auto -> each configured language -> Auto), the L is swallowed, auto-repeat cycles once. Mac keyhook needs the same: with Right Command held, L (keycode 37) -> emit ('lang', ...), swallow down+up. The rest (App, engine, pill flash, tray 'Next dictation in', Settings checkboxes) is shared.
